title: The food court situation, elder care, and the pool
content: My mall, the main one, is pretty normal mostly except that there is a mostly unspoken rule that you don’t stay after a certain time because of all the vampires at the food court. I work at the mall at a bakery/gift shop and every now and again a vampire will hunt in the other parts of the mall but mostly they just chill at the food court until someone wanders in… I live in the the old airport hotel and the first few floors are normal, then upstairs it’s all the elderly and some organization brings their meals to a large common dining room several times daily… The hotel pool is viewable from 2 levels of the airport shopping center, it is a long octagon (gem shaped) lots of fake plants and a green marble (or jade) and gold decor scheme…it is indoor but made to look outdoors with arches and windows…no one in it, water isn’t dirty
